title: Next SEO Moves
summary: It checks what your site and two rivals rank for, today's Google results and the pages involved, then lists the five SEO changes most worth your time.
outcome: Your next five SEO moves: which page to fix or write, the exact edit, and why.
boundary: Recommends only and never edits or publishes your site. Monthly searches rank the options; they are not a traffic forecast, and rankings are not promised. One market, sampled; technical SEO, indexing and backlinks are not checked.

catalog_tools.purpose: Sample what the site and two rivals rank for in one market, 100 rows each.
Find two rivals when the user has not named them.
Check monthly searches, difficulty, intent and results-page features, including AI Overviews, for up to 20 shortlisted phrases.
Read today's results page for each candidate move: who ranks, what kind of page wins and whether an AI Overview shows.
Check with a site: search that no existing page already covers a proposed new page; backup results page when a location code is unknown.
Read the home page, the site's pages behind updates and the rival pages behind new pages.
Re-read a page whose main content came back empty; only when needed and within budget.

inputs: Country and language (default United States, English)
What you sell, to whom, and topics to avoid (optional; otherwise read from your home page)
Up to two rivals (optional; otherwise found automatically)
A Search Console export of your queries and pages (optional; uses your real positions, so the evidence goes from Medium to Strong)
outputs: Five numbered moves: create or update which page, the exact edit, why (with the number behind it) and the effort
Which of those results pages show an AI Overview
A short list of topics held back, with reasons
A Brief this page plan for each new page, ready for Article Brief + Draft
Details: what was checked, sources, costs and limits

cost.model: Pay per call: three 100-row ranking samples, a 20-phrase overview, one live results page per move and a few page reads.
cost.notes: Inspected 14 October 2026: ranking samples, rival finding and the overview cost $0.016800 per call plus $0.000200 per row or phrase; live results page $0.014000; site search $0.002500; page read $0.003300; backup read $0.002500. Default maximum $0.275800 ($0.255000 with named rivals); most runs spend less. Shown and approved before the first paid call, and re-inspected on every run.

approvals: Shows the maximum cost before the first paid call and waits for your yes
Asks again before anything bigger: more rivals, rows, pages or markets, or more than $0.30
Never edits or publishes anything on your site
compatibility: One Scrollport connection (CLI, MCP or API) with search, inspect, run and wallet access
A local folder or conversation state for progress, the result and plan files
